attackers_goals: An attack may exfiltrate data from an EC2 instance to an S3 bucket outside the account.
description: A running or stopped instance was exported to an Amazon S3 bucket.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Stealth Tactics, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check the identity that exported the instance. Check to which S3 bucket the EC2 was exported into. Check the S3 bucket permission and policy.
name: AWS EC2 instance exported into S3
